sections.h2: Why regular mowing suits established Woden gardens
paras: Mature trees drop leaves and small branches, hedges push out over paths, and shaded lawns grow unevenly. A regular schedule handles all of that in small visits instead of a big rescue job twice a year.

Regular lawn mowing Woden Valley wide also keeps grass at a steady height through spring, which shades out bindi and broadleaf weeds and helps the lawn hold moisture into summer. On the larger O'Malley and Isaacs blocks, a fortnightly cut is far less work than a monthly one.

Hard frosts from May to August slow lawns to a crawl, so we drop to a monthly tidy and keep the cut high. From September the growth surge kicks in and kikuyu, couch and fescue lawns need fortnightly attention. Summers are hot and dry, so we cut higher.

Autumn is the big one here. The deciduous street plantings in Curtin, Hughes, Pearce and Mawson drop a serious amount of leaf, and we rake, mow and remove it with the clippings so the garden goes into winter clean.

Call 0423 720 317, email info@downtherabbitholeaust.com or send the form below with your suburb and a note about the block. We give you a free upfront quote and set a schedule if you want one. For lawn mowing Woden wide, fortnightly in the growing season and monthly through winter is the most common arrangement.

faqs.q: Do you do lawn mowing Woden Valley wide, or only certain suburbs?
faqs.a: All of it. Phillip, Chifley, O'Malley, Mawson, Pearce, Torrens, Farrer, Isaacs, Curtin, Hughes and Lyons are all on our runs. If you are on the edge of the district, call with your street and we will confirm.

faqs.q: Can you trim our old hedge as part of the mowing visit?
faqs.a: Yes. Established hedges are common in Woden Valley and we trim them as part of a regular visit or as a one-off. Tell us the height and shape you want, and we take the clippings away. Large or overgrown hedges are quoted after a look.

faqs.q: Do you take the leaves and clippings away?
faqs.a: Yes, every time. Green waste is removed after every lawn mowing Woden Valley visit, and after garden maintenance and clean-ups too. In autumn that includes the leaf drop from street trees, which we rake and load with the clippings.

faqs.q: We have a small townhouse lawn near Phillip. Is that too small to bother with?
faqs.a: No. Small lawns and shared strata areas are a regular part of our lawn mowing Woden Valley runs. A quick, tidy cut with clean edges makes a big difference to a townhouse frontage, and a schedule means it never gets overlooked.
